read_file: read the contents of a file at a given path and return the text
write_file: write text content to a file at a given path, overwriting if it exists
edit_file: apply find-and-replace edits to a file with optional dry-run diff preview
search_content: search for text content within files in a directory recursively by line
delete_path: delete a file or directory using a two-step confirmation token process
